Das Schloss liegt nahe dem Stadtzentrum und ist über die umliegenden Straßen erreichbar.
Strehla lies on the Elbe in the district of Meißen and has medieval origins.
Strehla Castle developed from a fortified complex and its present form contains elements from several historical periods.
The castle is close to the town centre and can be reached by the surrounding roads.
